The CCEH gives its tunes as four-part scores; this page has the melody only, read from its MIDI file and checked against its incipit, and NoteFusion's engine wrote the solfa from the notes. It has not yet been checked against a printed hymn book.

Questions about The Radiant Morn

What is the doh of The Radiant Morn?

In this version, in D major, doh is D. If your choir sings it in another key, doh moves to the new key note and every solfa syllable stays the same — that is what movable doh means.

What note does The Radiant Morn start on?

It starts on m (F♯ in D major), a pickup before the first full bar. Find doh first, then sing up or down to m.

What words can be sung to The Radiant Morn?

The Radiant Morn is in the metre 8.8.8.8 — Long Metre (L.M.): lines of 8, 8, 8, 8 syllables. Words written in the same metre fit it, such as 'Take Up Thy Cross', the Savior Said, 'Tis Midnight and on Olive's Brow, 'Twas on That Dark, That Doleful Night; check where the stresses fall before you sing them together.

Is The Radiant Morn in the public domain?

Yes. Charles Francois Gounod died in 1893; the tune was first published in 1872. Everyone named died before 1955 and it was published before 1929, so the tune is out of copyright in Nigeria, the UK, the EU and the United States. Modern arrangements of it can still be under copyright.
